name: 回復アイテム_饅頭_v1.png
prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: single Sengoku-era recovery-food pickup sprite for a 2D beat-'em-up
Input images: Image 1 is only the game's painted sprite style reference; do not reproduce any people.
Composition/framing: one complete food item centered in one 256x256 square cell, resting on the ground and occupying about 70-80% of the canvas, at least 20px clear margin.
Style/medium: detailed painted anime-realistic 2D arcade sprite, crisp dark outline, cel-shaded highlights, natural food textures, consistent with Image 1.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) magenta (#FF00FF), no floor or cast shadow.
Constraints: one recognizable pickup food item only, no characters, plate, cutlery, wrapper text, label, border, extra props or watermark.
Primary request: one traditional Japanese steamed manju bun as a recovery pickup. A single plump round off-white bun with a clear soft pleated seam at the crown and gently browned steam marks, set slightly on its side. It should read as a bun, not rice or dumpling soup.
Materials/textures: soft steamed dough, subtle flour surface and warm highlights.
Avoid: plate, basket, multiple buns, printed marks, toothpicks, text.
